journal.text: Initial $50k deployed $49k into recent relative-strength names, retaining $1k cash. As of Sep 30 APP 718.54 vs Jul 29 361.63, STX 236.06 vs 152.68, MU 167.32 vs 111.96, ASML 968.09 vs 718.49, TSLA 444.72 vs 321.20, LRCX 133.90 vs 98.94; NVDA 186.58 rebounded, INSM 144.01 provides biotech diversification. Dollar orders avoid overnight share-count failures. Monitor closes; trim names breaking September support or deteriorating in relative momentum, reallocate to stronger eligible names or cash. APP and TSLA volatile; reassess on sharp reversals.

Hold existing momentum positions. Oct 1 closes strengthened STX, MU, ASML, TSLA, LRCX and NVDA versus Sep 30; APP slipped modestly but has not justified a one-day reversal, while INSM remained positive. Keep $500 cash. Reassess on sustained relative-strength deterioration, breaks of September support, or a materially stronger eligible opportunity.

Hold eight positions and $505 cash. Oct 2 APP fell to 683.64 after two declines but remains above Sep 26 close 669.86; TSLA reversed to 436 yet holds its Sep 25 close 423.39. STX 254.74, MU 183.75, ASML 1030.17, LRCX 146.99 and INSM 152.80 retain strong September trends, with NVDA 188.89 near recent highs. No conviction to rotate after a single weak session in APP/TSLA. Reconsider if APP closes below ~670 or TSLA below ~420, or if multiple holdings lose recent breakout levels; limit tech concentration if broader trend deteriorates.

Hold eight positions and $505 cash. Oct 3 closes: APP 682.76 remains above ~670 watch level despite three declines; TSLA 429.83 is above ~420 but its second high-volume decline warrants caution. MU 187.83 and INSM 157.16 made fresh recent closing highs; STX 252.79, ASML 1032.22, LRCX 145.81 and NVDA 187.62 remain near highs. Avoid chasing extensions or selling on a still-unconfirmed support break. Reconsider APP on close below ~670, TSLA below ~420, or broad semiconductor momentum reversal; redeploy into stronger names or cash if those occur.

Sell APP: Oct 6 close $587 (-14% versus Oct 3), decisively under the ~670 support watched in prior journals; intraday low $545 and 14.4m volume versus 4.2m on Oct 3 confirm an unusually severe reversal. Rotate approximately $6,000 into SHOP ($164.50 after Oct 3 high-volume breakout) and CEG ($364.10, near recent highs), diversifying away from the concentrated semiconductor holdings; leave remaining proceeds as a cushion for an adverse APP opening gap. Hold other positions: MU, ASML, LRCX, INSM retain uptrends, while TSLA rebounded to $453.25; monitor STX's pullback to $242.83. Reassess if SHOP closes under ~$150, CEG under ~$340, STX below ~$220, or multiple chip positions lose their recent breakout levels. If APP recovers and sustains a new base, reconsider only after confirmation.

Exit STX: Oct 7 fell to $225.01 (-7.3%) on 10.0m shares, roughly double recent volume, closing below its Oct 1 breakout area (~$234) and Sep 22 close ($229). This is close to the prior ~$220 risk threshold, and the semiconductor holdings also declined; retain proceeds in cash rather than immediately increasing correlated exposure. Hold MU, ASML, LRCX and NVDA for now as their longer September advances remain intact, and hold INSM, TSLA, SHOP and CEG. Reconsider STX after a sustained reclaim of ~$235; trim other chip exposure if selling continues through recent bases (MU ~$180, ASML ~$950, LRCX ~$130). Reassess TSLA below ~$420, SHOP below ~$150, and CEG below ~$340.

Add $3,500 CRWD, diversifying from chips: Oct 8 closed $509.95 near its $510 intraday high, up 5.2% on 3.62m shares versus 2.86m Oct 7, clearing the recent ~$500 ceiling after the pullback. Retain ~$5,280 cash and existing holdings. MU rebounded to $196.54, LRCX to $142.54 and NVDA to $189.11, while ASML $987.81 remains over the ~$950 risk area; no confirmed break in those positions. Avoid chasing AMD after a 43% three-session surge and keep STX sidelined below ~$235. Reconsider CRWD if it closes below ~$480; cut chip risk if MU loses ~$180, ASML ~$950 or LRCX ~$130. Reassess TSLA under ~$420, SHOP under ~$150, CEG under ~$340.

Add $2,500 to CEG: Oct 9 closed $383.23 near its $386.86 high, above the prior $376.78 high; its advance diversifies the semiconductor-heavy portfolio. Keep roughly $2,780 cash and hold other positions: MU $192.33, ASML $980.54 and LRCX $141 remain above their watched support levels; NVDA $192.57 and INSM $164.40 remain firm. Avoid STX ($221.70, still below ~$235) and AMD after its steep run. Reconsider CEG on a close below ~$355 or failed breakout below ~$370; trim chips if MU closes below ~$180, ASML ~$950 or LRCX ~$130. Reassess TSLA below ~$420, SHOP below ~$150 and CRWD below ~$480.

Reduce risk after Oct 10's broad, heavy-volume late selloff. Exit ASML: $936.19 closed below watched $950 on 2.93m shares, nearly twice Oct 9 volume. Exit TSLA: $413.49 breached $420 with 112m shares. Exit CEG: $368.49 erased its $370 breakout after reaching $392.18 intraday, invalidating the recent add. Keep MU ($181.60) and LRCX ($131.37) for now, just above their $180/$130 risk levels; NVDA, INSM, SHOP and CRWD remain held. Keep proceeds in cash pending stabilization; reconsider ASML above $950, TSLA above $420 and CEG above $375 with sustained closes. Cut MU below $180, LRCX below $130, SHOP below $150 or CRWD below $480 on a closing basis; reassess if the broader selloff accelerates.

Reenter ASML ($3,000) and CEG ($3,000) after Oct 13's broad rebound, but keep about $14,107 cash because one session does not confirm recovery. ASML closed $984.66, back above the watched $950 level, on 2.22m shares; CEG closed $380.91, back over $375 on 3.27m shares, providing some diversification from chips. MU $192.77 and LRCX $137.81 reclaimed room over $180/$130; retain NVDA, INSM, SHOP and CRWD. Reconsider ASML below $950, CEG below $370, MU below $180, LRCX below $130, SHOP below $150 or CRWD below $480 on closes; deploy more cash only if stabilization persists.

Buy $3,000 WMT to diversify away from the chip-heavy book: Oct 14 closed $107.21 above its prior 40-session high of $106.11, on 30.86m shares versus roughly 15m typical. Keep about $11,107 cash as the Oct 13 technology rebound faltered: NVDA fell to $180.03, MU to $187.06, and CRWD to $488.94. Retain existing positions; CEG advanced to $389.56 despite wide intraday volatility. Reassess WMT if it closes below ~$103, NVDA below ~$175, MU below $180, LRCX below $130, ASML below $950, CEG below $370, SHOP below $150 or CRWD below $480. Deploy more cash only on broader stabilization.

Add $2,000 WMT and initiate $2,500 GOOG, retaining roughly $6,607 cash. WMT extended its Oct 14 high-volume breakout, closing Oct 15 at $109.03 on 21.4m shares; GOOG recovered from Oct 10's $237.49 close to $251.71, just above its Oct 6 closing high. Both diversify a book concentrated in semiconductors. MU ($191.94), LRCX ($144.78), ASML ($1,009.81) and CEG ($403.95) recovered, but NVDA ($179.83) remains weak; avoid adding chip exposure. Reconsider WMT below $103, GOOG below $242, NVDA below $175, MU below $180, LRCX below $130, ASML below $950, CEG below $370, SHOP below $150 or CRWD below $480 on closes; deploy remaining cash if broader strength persists.

Hold all positions and $6,607 cash. MU broke above its Oct 6 high, closing Oct 16 at $202.53 on 42.0m shares, so retain the winner despite its ~18% portfolio weight. Broad confirmation is weak: LRCX reversed from $147.58 to $142.37, WMT fell from $109.03 to $106.47, and CRWD closed $482.23, near the $480 risk level. GOOG held $251.88 but faded from its $257.58 intraday high. Do not chase additional technology exposure today. Reconsider CRWD on a close below $480, WMT below $103, GOOG below $242, MU below $180, NVDA below $175, LRCX below $130, ASML below $950, CEG below $370 or SHOP below $150; deploy cash after stronger breadth or a sustained breakout.

Initiate $3,000 GILD, leaving about $3,607 cash. GILD closed Oct 17 at $122.81, above its prior 20-session closing high of $118.48, on 15.85m shares versus roughly 7m typical; adds established biotech exposure without increasing chip concentration. Hold current positions: MU sustained its breakout at $202.38; INSM reached $165.76; GOOG $253.79 and WMT $107.73 held their recent recoveries. CEG retreated to $386.50 and CRWD recovered to $484.65, warranting caution rather than adding. Reconsider GILD on a close below $116, CRWD below $480, CEG below $370, WMT below $103, MU below $180, NVDA below $175, LRCX below $130, ASML below $950, SHOP below $150 or GOOG below $242; invest remaining cash after broader confirmation.

Add $2,000 GOOG; retain approximately $1,607 cash and all existing holdings. GOOG closed Oct 20 at $257.02, above its Sept 19 close of $255.24 after recovering from $237.49 on Oct 10; adding to this relatively small position diversifies a semiconductor-heavy account. MU advanced to $206.77 and INSM to $167.91; hold their trends rather than chase them. CEG fell sharply to $370 after trading at $398.50 intraday, so do not add; sell/reassess if it closes below $370 or fails to stabilize. Reconsider GOOG below $242, GILD below $116, CRWD below $480, WMT below $103, MU below $180, NVDA below $175, LRCX below $130, ASML below $950 and SHOP below $150. Preserve residual cash if breadth weakens.

Exit CEG: Oct 21 close $358.79 broke the previously set $370 risk level, after reversing from $403.95 on Oct 15 and $370 on Oct 20. Reallocate $1,500 to GILD, which closed at $124.08 above its Oct 17 high-volume breakout close of $122.81; leave roughly $3,000 cash against broad softness in GOOG, NVDA, MU and WMT. Retain other holdings, with MU and LRCX still above their October pullback lows. Reconsider GILD below $116, GOOG below $242, CRWD below $480, WMT below $103, MU below $180, NVDA below $175, LRCX below $130, ASML below $950, SHOP below $150 or INSM below $155. Revisit CEG only after stabilization above $370.

Hold all positions and $2,997 cash. Oct 22 weakness was broad, but none of the previously identified closing risk levels broke: MU $198.47 > $180, LRCX $141.25 > $130, NVDA $180.28 > $175, INSM $160.40 > $155, SHOP $162.01 > $150, CRWD $500.11 > $480, ASML $1,011.57 > $950, WMT $107.14 > $103, GOOG $252.53 > $242, GILD $121.46 > $116. Avoid buying the pullback while chip exposure is already substantial; CEG continued down to $350.06, so no reentry. Reassess on closes through those risk levels or renewed strength and broader participation before deploying cash.

Hold all positions and $2,997 cash. Oct 23 rebound lifted MU to $206.71, LRCX to $147.54, SHOP to $167.03 and CRWD to a recent closing high of $521.98; no closing risk level was breached. INSM touched $154.79 intraday but recovered to $160.12, above the $155 closing threshold. With semiconductor exposure already large and NVDA still below its Oct 9 high, wait for sustained breadth before adding. Reassess on closes below INSM $155, NVDA $175, MU $180, LRCX $130, SHOP $150, CRWD $480, ASML $950, WMT $103, GOOG $242 or GILD $116; reconsider cash deployment if strength persists.

Deploy $2,500 of the $2,997 cash into GOOG and SHOP, leaving roughly $497. Oct 24 closes confirmed broader strength: GOOG $260.51 exceeded its Oct 20 closing high $257.02, SHOP $172.95 surpassed its earlier October high, and MU $219.02, LRCX $151.68 and CRWD $527.32 also advanced. Add outside semiconductors, already a large portfolio weight; retain WMT and GILD for diversification. Reconsider on closes below GOOG $242, SHOP $150, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480, ASML $950, WMT $103 or GILD $116; avoid further additions if the breakout reverses.

Hold positions and $497 cash. Oct 27 closes extended strength in GOOG ($269.93), LRCX ($156.90), NVDA ($191.49) and MU ($220.10); SHOP ($175.06) and CRWD ($529.70) also held gains. WMT weakened to $104.47, close to its $103 risk level, but has not broken it; GILD $120.47 remains above $116. Avoid chasing a third strong session or adding to already sizable semiconductor exposure. Reassess on closing breaks below WMT $103, GILD $116, GOOG $242, SHOP $150, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480 or ASML $950.

Hold the ten positions and $503 cash. Oct 28 NVDA broke above its prior October high on elevated volume ($201.03 close), while MU $221.91, SHOP $178.96 and CRWD $546.94 stayed strong. WMT slid to $103.17 (intraday low $103.05), just above the precommitted $103 closing risk level; GILD fell to $117.88, still above $116. Do not add to concentrated semiconductor exposure or sell defensive holdings ahead of the established closing triggers. Reconsider on closes below WMT $103, GILD $116, GOOG $242, SHOP $150, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480 or ASML $950; assess breadth before putting new cash to work.

Sell WMT after its Oct 29 close at $102.46 broke the precommitted $103 closing risk level; the Oct 15–29 decline has erased its mid-October surge. Hold the other nine positions: GILD closed $118.50, above its $116 level, and GOOG, MU, LRCX and NVDA remain strong. Keep the sale proceeds in cash rather than chase an already semiconductor-heavy rally; reassess deployment after new price confirmation. Reconsider on closes below GILD $116, GOOG $242, SHOP $150, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480 or ASML $950; reconsider WMT if it regains $107 on a closing basis.

Hold nine positions and $5,232 cash. Oct 30 INSM surged to $194.22 on unusually high volume; GOOG closed higher at $281.90 despite retreating from its $291.72 open. MU, NVDA and SHOP pulled back, while broader growth names weakened; none of our established closing risk levels broke. Avoid chasing INSM's one-day spike or increasing semiconductor concentration ahead of confirmation. Reconsider on closing breaks below GILD $116, GOOG $242, SHOP $150, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480 or ASML $950; deploy cash if strength broadens and stabilizes.

Deploy $42,000 of the new monthly deposit across seven names, retaining about $13,232 cash; keep the nine existing holdings, whose Oct 31 closes remain above established closing risk levels. CSCO closed $73.11 at a 35-session high with stronger volume; AMZN closed $244.22 after an unusually large-volume earnings gap (size modest due to intraday fade); AAPL $270.37 remains in a rising trend despite its reversal. REGN held near $652 for four sessions after its high-volume Oct 28 breakout; BKR $48.41 provides energy diversification; ZS $331.14 broke out of a monthlong range on higher volume; ISRG $534.28 holds most of its Oct 22 gap, but declining from $551 warrants small size. Reassess new positions on closes under CSCO $69, AMZN $229, AAPL $258, REGN $625, BKR $45.5, ZS $313 or ISRG $520; existing GILD $116, GOOG $242, SHOP $150, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480, ASML $950. Avoid further semiconductor additions until breadth confirms.

Hold all 16 positions and $13,255 cash after yesterday's $42,000 deployment. Nov 3 closes stayed above every precommitted closing risk level: MU $234.70, LRCX $161.24, NVDA $206.88, GOOG $284.12, and CSCO $74.45 remain firm; AMZN extended to $254 and ZS to $336.27. SHOP weakened on elevated volume and REGN dipped intraday to $627.50 but closed $642.25, above its $625 closing threshold; monitor both rather than trade on a single intraday move. Avoid additional exposure immediately after deployment. Reconsider on closes below CSCO $69, AMZN $229, AAPL $258, REGN $625, BKR $45.5, ZS $313, ISRG $520, GILD $116, GOOG $242, SHOP $150, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480 or ASML $950; consider deploying cash if broad strength persists.

Hold 16 positions and $13,255 cash. Nov 4 was a broad growth/semiconductor selloff: MU fell to $218.03, NVDA $198.69, SHOP $160.94 on elevated volume, but none of the established closing risk levels broke. REGN $628 is barely above $625 after two declines and BKR $45.97 is near $45.50 after a high-volume drop; monitor closely rather than sell ahead of the previously stated closing triggers. Do not deploy cash into this weakness. Reconsider if REGN closes under $625, BKR under $45.50, SHOP under $150, CSCO under $69, or other established levels break (AMZN $229, AAPL $258, ZS $313, ISRG $520, GILD $116, GOOG $242, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480, ASML $950); consider new buys only after stabilization and broader strength.

Hold 16 positions and $13,255 cash. Nov 5 rebound was mixed: MU recovered to $237.50 on strong volume, LRCX $165.05, REGN $644.19, BKR $47.04 and ISRG $548.55 recovered; NVDA fell again to $195.21, ZS to $323.90 and CSCO to $72.10. Every existing closing risk threshold remains intact, but one mixed rebound after a broad selloff does not justify adding exposure. Reconsider on closes under REGN $625, BKR $45.50, SHOP $150, CSCO $69, AMZN $229, AAPL $258, ZS $313, ISRG $520, GILD $116, GOOG $242, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480 or ASML $950; deploy cash if breadth strengthens sustainably.

Hold 16 positions and $13,255 cash. Nov 6 renewed broad weakness: NVDA $188.08, SHOP $156.05, ZS $317.92, CSCO $71.04 and AMZN $243.04 fell, while MU $238.33 and REGN $646.87 held up. AMD, META, MSFT and PLTR also declined; avoid deploying reserve into weak breadth. No previously established closing threshold broke. Reconsider on closes under REGN $625, BKR $45.50, SHOP $150, CSCO $69, AMZN $229, AAPL $258, ZS $313, ISRG $520, GILD $116, GOOG $242, MU $180, LRCX $130, NVDA $175, INSM $155, CRWD $480 or ASML $950; add only after sustained broad stabilization.

Hold 16 positions and $13,261 cash. Nov 7 was mixed: ISRG closed $560, REGN $657.53, INSM $189.70 and CRWD $539.81 strengthened, but SHOP slid to $152.41 near its $150 risk level, GILD fell to $118.84, and NVDA $188.15 and ASML $1016.96 remain soft. No established closing risk threshold broke; mixed breadth does not yet warrant deploying the reserve. Reconsider if SHOP closes below $150, GILD below $116, ZS below $313, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, BKR below $45.50 or other established levels break; add selectively if broad strength persists.

Add $3,500 to ISRG, retaining about $9,761 cash. Its Nov 10 close of $576.20 exceeded the recent $562.65 high on 3.07m shares, after Friday's rise to $560; broad tech and semiconductor prices also rebounded, though it is only one strong session. Existing 16 holdings remain above their established closing risk levels. Limit deployment until breadth proves durable. Reconsider the addition if ISRG closes below $545, and reassess the overall position below $520; review SHOP below $150, GILD below $116, ZS below $313, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, BKR below $45.50, or a renewed broad selloff.

Hold all 16 positions and $9,761 cash. Nov 11 semiconductor weakness (MU $241.11, LRCX $159.18, NVDA $193.16, ASML $1022.42) reversed some of Monday's rebound; AMD, AVGO and AMAT also fell. REGN advanced to $674.55, GOOG to $291.74 and AAPL to $275.25; ISRG eased to $572.17 after its breakout, still above the $545 addition-review level. No established closing risk threshold broke. Avoid adding into mixed breadth with roughly 91% already invested. Reconsider ISRG below $545 (full position below $520), SHOP below $150, GILD below $116, ZS below $313, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, BKR below $45.50, or other prior risk levels; deploy cash if broad strength becomes sustained.

Hold 16 positions and $9,761 cash. Nov 12 was mixed: MU recovered to $244.90 and LRCX to $161.42, while NVDA stayed near $193.80; AMD surged, but META and SHOP declined. CSCO rose to $73.96 on 57.6m volume and REGN advanced to $681.72; ZS fell sharply to $317.08, close to its $313 review threshold. ISRG held $572.45 above its $545 addition-review level. No established closing risk threshold has broken, and 91% invested limits the case for another buy amid uneven breadth. Reassess ZS below $313, SHOP below $150, ISRG below $545 (full position below $520), GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, BKR below $45.50, or renewed broad weakness; deploy reserve selectively if strength broadens and persists.

Exit SHOP and ZS: Nov 13 closes $146.34 and $308.60 breached the previously documented $150 and $313 closing review levels. SHOP dropped 6.5% on 11.35m shares and has declined from its Oct 29 $179.01 close; ZS fell for a second consecutive session. Broader weakness in MU, LRCX, NVDA, AMZN and GOOG argues against immediate redeployment. Retain other 14 positions and hold proceeds plus existing cash; reassess the exits on sustained recoveries above $150/$313 with improving breadth. Review ISRG below $545 (full position below $520), GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, BKR below $45.50 and any broad further selloff.

Hold 14 positions and $18,173 cash. Nov 14 was mixed: MU rebounded to $246.83 on elevated volume, and NVDA recovered to $190.17, but LRCX declined to $148.26, AMZN to $234.69 and GOOG to $276.98. ISRG fell to $549.51, close to its $545 review level; CSCO held $78 and REGN $693.50. SHOP $146.04 and ZS $299.45 remain below last session's exit levels, so do not rebuy. No established closing sell threshold has broken; avoid deploying cash before broader, sustained stabilization. Reassess ISRG on a close below $545 (exit review below $520), AMZN below $229, LRCX below $130, NVDA below $175, GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, BKR below $45.50 or a broad further selloff.

Hold 14 positions and $18,173 cash. Nov 17 breadth remained uneven: MU reversed from an intraday $260.58 to $241.95, LRCX slipped to $147.46, NVDA to $186.60, and AMZN to $232.87, near its $229 review level. SHOP ($139.93) and ZS ($294.92) weakened further after our exits. Offsetting strength in GOOG ($285.60), REGN ($704.31) and INSM ($197.40) does not yet justify deploying reserve; no previously established closing sell level has broken. Reconsider on closes below AMZN $229, ISRG $545 (exit review below $520), LRCX $130, NVDA $175, GILD $116, CSCO $69, REGN $625 or BKR $45.50; selectively invest cash if breadth stabilizes across several sessions.

Exit AMZN: Nov 18 close $222.55 breached the previously flagged $229 review level, erased its late-October breakout, and fell 4.4% on 60.6m shares. Retain other holdings but avoid redeploying amid weakness in MU ($228.50), LRCX ($143.24), NVDA ($181.36) and CRWD ($513.67); relative strength in REGN ($725.34), INSM ($201.62), and GILD ($127.18) provides some balance. Reconsider AMZN after sustained recovery above $229 with improving breadth; reassess LRCX below $130, NVDA below $175, ISRG below $545 (exit review below $520), GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, BKR below $45.50, or if broader declines persist. Keep sale proceeds in cash for now.

Hold 13 positions and $24,314 cash. Nov 19 was mixed rather than a confirmed recovery: MU slipped to $225.92 after testing $216.36, while NVDA rebounded to $186.52, LRCX to $148.80, GOOG to $292.99, and ISRG to $564.64; INSM and GILD continued higher. AMZN remains below its $229 reentry-review level. No established closing exit level was breached, so avoid reacting to one day's intraday swings or deploying reserve before broader stabilization. Review MU on a close below $216, NVDA below $175, LRCX below $130, ISRG below $545 (exit review below $520), GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625 and BKR below $45.50; reconsider cash deployment on sustained improvement in breadth.

Exit MU: Nov 20 close $201.37 broke the previously flagged $216 closing review level, down 10.9% on 47.4m shares after opening $230.24. The sharp high-to-close reversal across NVDA, LRCX, ASML and CRWD argues against deploying the $24,314 reserve or chasing WMT's one-day jump. Retain the other 12 positions for now; revisit NVDA below $175, LRCX below $130, ISRG below $545 (exit review $520), GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625 and BKR below $45.50. Review ASML below $975 and CRWD below $495; consider redeployment only after multiple sessions of broader stabilization, and MU reentry after recovery above $216.

Exit ASML and CRWD after their Nov 21 closes ($966.57 and $490.67) breached the $975/$495 review levels flagged last session; both declined for a second day on elevated volume while NVDA, AMD and MSFT remained weak. Keep the other ten positions, including comparatively strong GOOG and REGN, and retain sale proceeds plus existing cash rather than treating Friday's partial rebound as a confirmed broad recovery. Reconsider ASML above $1005 and CRWD above $515 with sustained breadth improvement; reassess NVDA below $175, LRCX below $130, ISRG below $545 (exit review $520), GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625 and BKR below $45.50 on a closing basis.

Hold ten positions and $40,028 cash. Nov 24 delivered a broad rebound (LRCX $150.38, NVDA $182.55, GOOG $318.47), but one session does not yet establish a sustained reversal after the Nov 20–21 selloff. GOOG's 6.3% advance on 55.3m shares and REGN's continued strength favor keeping winners; avoid chasing GOOG, AVGO's 11% surge, or immediately repurchasing ASML/CRWD, still below the previously flagged $1005/$515 reentry levels. Consider incremental cash deployment if several sessions sustain improved breadth; revisit NVDA on closes below $175, LRCX below $130, ISRG below $545 (exit review $520), GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, and BKR below $45.50.

Deploy $6,000 of the $40,028 reserve into AMAT; retain the ten existing positions and roughly $34,028 cash. AMAT closed Nov 25 at $242.46, up 5.0% after its Nov 24 gain, above its recent $235 area; LRCX also advanced, but NVDA and AMD fell, so keep the addition modest rather than assume a broad recovery. GOOG and REGN remain strong; ASML $1003.22 and CRWD $512.34 remain below the previously set $1005/$515 reentry marks. Reassess AMAT if it closes below $224, NVDA below $175, LRCX below $130, ISRG below $545 (exit review $520), GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, BKR below $45.50; deploy more cash only on sustained improvement in market breadth.

Reenter ASML with $6,000, retaining the eleven existing holdings and approximately $28,028 cash. Its Nov 26 close of $1,040.97 cleared the prior $1,005 reentry mark; AMAT, LRCX, AMD, MU and MSFT also rose, supporting a modest increase in exposure, though NVDA remains weak and CRWD fell back below $515. ASML joins existing AMAT and LRCX, so limit the addition rather than exhaust reserves. Review ASML on a close below $1,005, AMAT below $224, NVDA below $175, LRCX below $130, ISRG below $545 (exit review $520), GILD below $116, CSCO below $69, REGN below $625, or BKR below $45.50; consider further deployment only if breadth remains firm.

Deploy $42,000 of the new monthly deposit across seven names; keep the twelve existing positions and approximately $36,028 cash.
